nom: Lancôme Crème Radiance Clarifying Cream-to-Foam Cleanser

segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skinned reviewers are largely positive, describing no burning, redness, or breakouts and calling it the only cleanser some can tolerate; the exception is a long-time sensitive-skin user who says a recent reformulation added fragrance and left her skin feeling unclean and irritated.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or combination-dry skin generally report the cleanser doesn't strip or dry out their skin, including through winter; one reviewer with increasingly dry, aging skin felt the formula suits combination-to-oily skin better than drier or more mature skin.
segments.combination: Combination-skinned reviewers, including combination-oily and combination-dry variants, consistently report a good balance — cleansing well without leaving skin dry or oily, some after decades of use.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or combination-oily skin report the cleanser helps reduce oiliness and clears out large pores, especially in summer, without stripping the skin.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 50s and 70s report the cleanser leaves skin soft and not tight, with one 71-year-old crediting it for a much younger-looking complexion; one reviewer in her 40s with increasingly dry skin felt it suits combination-to-oily skin better than more mature skin.

concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, across dry, oily and combination skin, report the cleanser does not strip or dry out the skin — many specifically say it leaves skin soft and hydrated rather than tight; no reviewer in this set reports it causing dryness.
concerns.oiliness: Most reports say the cleanser controls oiliness and helps clear out large pores in warmer months without leaving skin greasy; one reviewer who missed a discontinued mousse version found this cream formula itself feels oily on her skin.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with acne-prone or breakout-prone skin credit long-term use with clearer skin and no new breakouts, including one who broke out badly during a period she stopped using it and cleared up again once she resumed.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with reactive or easily irritated skin report this cleanser doesn't sting, burn, or leave skin feeling tight afterward, several contrasting it with previous cleansers that burned when rinsing or getting into the eyes; the reformulated version is the exception, described by one longtime sensitive-skin user as newly irritating.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with extremely sensitive skin, previously left red and burning by other 'sensitive skin' cleansers, reports this one causes no redness, no burning, and no tight skin afterward.
concerns.aging: A few long-term users associate the cleanser with a younger-looking complexion over time, including a 71-year-old who says her face looks decades younger and another who credits it, alongside other routine steps, with visibly reduced fine lines; these are subjective long-term impressions rather than a stated mechanism.

aspects.libelle: A little goes a very long way
Pricey, but seen as worth it long-term
Tube packaging makes dispensing the last bit hard
Gentle enough to not sting the eyes
Longtime fans mourn the discontinued mousse version

extraits.texte: Why did you change this product?! I have been using this product for 5+ years if not longer. Many women in my family also use this product. Why why why change it?! The formula is not the same and they added a scent. Why why why :( I have super sensitive skin and struggle to find skincare products that work for me. All of the reasons i loved this cleanser are now gone. The old one was so light and airy and was perfect as an end of day cleanser or a morning cleanser. It took my makeup off without stripping my skin dry. It was easy to dispense and lathered beautifully. This new one is sticky, does not lather at all, harder to dispense when I have makeup remover and water on my face / eyes, its SCENTED (why?!), sticky (again - why sticky?!), and leaves my face feeling unclean and irritated. I will not be repurchasing and will not recommend this product to anyone. I will let everyone I know who uses this product to start searching for a new option. Again I have been buying this product in bulk for years so this is truly devastating to me! Lancome PLEASE bring back the old product! Please!
I really prefer the Mousse Radiance which has been discontinued. The Creme Radiance is too creamy for me and feels oily on my skin.

extraits.titre: Nice for people with more combination to oily skin
extraits.texte: I have been a fan of the pink mouse cleanser for a while. I wanted to try this blue one out to see if it was as good as the pink one. However, personally for me, pink one is much better for me. I am in my 40s and my skin although used to be combination is becoming more and more dry. So I would say this is more suited for true combination to oily skin then dryer or more mature skin. The clean feel after washing my face is too strong to use everyday. But the pink one I love to use everyday and it does not feel strong.

I discovered this face wash in college, I'm 33 now and I still love it! It cleans your face so well and clears it of all makeup and dirt. It has a scent, and it ALWAYS has. For many of us scents are not a big deal, it honestly makes this product feel more luxe to me personally and does not negatively affect my skin. It also goes away right after you wash your face. For a few months about 10 years ago I stopped using it and my face was breaking out so bad. Once I got back to using this my face cleared completely after a few weeks. Also you need only a LITTLE bit. I've had tubes of this last me 6 or more months and I wash my face daily. I'm talking a pea sized amount you lather up and wash your face with. The people complaining of residue are using way too much. LOVE LOVE this face wash so much and always keep multiple backups of it. It's a steep price but trust me it's so concentrated it lasts way more than diluted liquidy face washes.

I have extremely sensitive skin. Ive tried countless cleansers that claim they're good for sensitive skin, only to be left with burning skin while cleansing, and then redness and tight dry skin upon drying. Tried this cleanser on a whim when I received it as a gift, and fell in love. A tiny bit really does go a long way, and the creamy lather feels good on my skin. It removes makeup effortlessly and my skin has truly never looked better. No breakouts, no redness, and no burning or tight skin after. This one is going to be staying with me for the long haul, and I really couldnt recommend it enough.

I have other facial cleanser and this one is the one I always repurchase. I have combination oily skin and this product helps reduce it. I always feel clean and it washes away my makeup or any impurities. A little goes a long way which is great, so this product lasts longer even when using it once or twice a day.

extraits.titre: Creme Radiance Leaves My Face Clean and Smooth
extraits.texte: Creme Radiance leaves my face clean and smooth. It's gentle foaming cream cleanses so well! I have used it for many years. At 71, I have a face that looks 50 or 60.
